name: domino
title: Domino
description: Four dominoes topple one after another and come to rest. Pure CSS keyframes, played once on mount.
author: yui540 <https://github.com/yui540>
docs:
Installed `Domino`. Import it from `@/components/ui/domino` and render `<Domino key={run} aria-label="Four dominoes toppling" />`.

It plays once on mount; change its `key` to play it again.
The keyframes live in the component file and React 19 hoists them into `<head>` once (`<style href precedence>`), so nothing is added to your global CSS. Colors come from the item's own variables (`--domino-1`, `--domino-2`, `--domino-3`, `--domino-4`, `--domino-surface`), with the upstream grays as fallbacks.

Reduced motion: no motion; the row shows its fallen end state.
